intro: We are so grateful for you! As many of you will be traveling to El Salvador to celebrate this special moment with us, your presence is truly the greatest gift we could ask for. If you wish to honor us with an additional gift, we have created a registry to help us build our home and begin this beautiful new chapter of our lives together. Thank you for being part of our journey!
note: If you'd like to give a monetary gift, cash or a gift card is always appreciated and can be brought to the wedding or sent digitally. Thank you so much for your generosity and love!
